card.name: Leading digit of multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (usually 1, 2, 3 or 4) that starts or sits inside a multi-digit number, such as a count, date, ratio or statistic. The pole responds as the number is still being written, before the next digits appear.

modes.label: Digits in fractions and counts
modes.description: A digit after a slash or open parenthesis in patient counts like 17/355.
modes.example: including treatment with insulin in 4.8% (17/<<3>>55) of patients.

modes.label: Digits in dates and ranks
modes.description: A leading digit in a date or ranking number.
modes.example: 07-26-2010: The FCC Celebrates the 20th Anniversary of the ADA - 07-<<2>>1-2010: Senate

modes.label: Digits in statistics
modes.description: A digit within a decimal, confidence interval or table value.

card.writes: It suppresses the digit 8 and the words eight, eighth, ninth and tenth, so the number being written is steered away from 8.
card.plain: It fires on the first digits of a number in the middle of being written, and it pushes the model away from continuing with an 8.
evidence: including treatment with insulin in 4.8% (17/<<3>>55) of patients.
